articles.title: US and China plan AI risk talks, @theojaffee says, citing Bessent
articles.summary: Citing Scott Bessent, @theojaffee says planned US-China AI talks would cover testing, human control and incident alerts.

articles.title: Reports say U.S. lawmakers move to further tighten China's access to advanced AI chips
articles.summary: Multiple accounts, citing the Financial Times, reported that U.S. lawmakers are moving to further cut off China's access to advanced AI chips in the wake of the Nvidia scandal.

articles.title: Jensen Huang turned a toast into a speech at dinner with Macron, attendee recalls
articles.summary: In @hidecloud’s telling, Huang arrived late, picked up a wine glass and delivered an “electric” improvised speech.

articles.title: Baseten set for roughly $30 billion valuation, Bloomberg reports
articles.summary: Bloomberg reports two planned valuation tiers for Baseten’s funding round: $26 billion and $30 billion.

articles.title: Jason offers $420.69 in “XMONEY” for Starship remixes, “AI slop” and all
articles.summary: Jason’s Starship-remix offer welcomes “AI slop” and music videos, but the post leaves “XMONEY” unexplained and sets no deadline.

articles.title: Foundation hasn’t paid employees since October 30, post citing CNBC says
articles.summary: A post citing CNBC says Foundation lent CEO Sankaet Pathak $4.6 million for a home last year.

articles.title: InferenceForge’s creator claims 43% more throughput—with the same latency rules
articles.summary: The creator’s AgentX claim concerns throughput under the same latency requirements, not a promise of 43% quicker replies.

articles.title: A Grok Bot user says it handled the rental-car hassle, partial refund included
articles.summary: altryne credits @bot with a partial Enterprise refund and a new drop-off arrangement, but the transaction remains unverified.

articles.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
articles.summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.

articles.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
articles.summary: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.

articles.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
articles.summary: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

articles.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.summary: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
articles.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

articles.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
articles.summary: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

articles.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
articles.summary: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.
